tripAdvisorReviews.name: Premier Inn London Holborn hotel
tripAdvisorReviews.address: 27-29 Red Lion Street Holborn, London WC1R 4PS England

reviews.title: Don't book this hotel!!!
reviews.text:
Single bed not comfortable. The one lift was reported not working back in Jan, the second lift stop working 18 February Sunday morning. Half the 6 th floor lost power Saturday night and was talking to another couple and their toilet was blocked. The hotel is old and badly needs an upgrade.
Stay away from this premier inn!!!

reviews.title: Convenient location
reviews.text:
The hotel is in a good location, easy to walk to Covent Garden and theatres,  it was also very quiet.
The room was as expected,  clean, decent bed, limited toiletries.

The receptionist that checked us in was quite abrupt and not at all friendly.  Guests were almost an inconvenience to her. The other staff were friendly enough, but no-one went above and beyond their job role.

If you want a clean bed, easy location for a weekend stay, it's ideal.

reviews.title: Great, quiet location and hotel in central london
reviews.text: The hotel was easy to find, near holborn station, on a quiet street yet near central london. Great in-room amenities, including good hairdryer/make up areas and tea and coffee facilities. Very comfy bed - I had a great nights sleep

reviews.title: Worst Premier Inn I have ever booked
reviews.text: Worst Premier Inn I have ever booked.  I checked out the same evening I checked in. Noise in the room was unbearable coming from the ceiling, it sounded like a generator. Rude and unhelpful staff. After paying in full for 2 nights, they then charged my card another £192 when I checked out!!! Reception area is dirty, only 1 lift working. Reception never staffed. Refused to transfer me to another Premier Inn, so I had to pay again for another 2 nights stay. I certainly will never return or recommend this place. I asked to speak to a manager and was told they had gone home by the extremely rude member of staff. I rang the next day to ask why they had charged me after paying in full and was told I would be called back. 3 days later and NO call. Luckily Guest Relations sorted this. Staff need retraining in customer service and how to use the booking system.

reviews.title: Worst hotel ever
reviews.text: After their own mistake which I have email to provide the duty manager refused to get an manager and just directed me to some number to ring which I couldn’t be bothered they over charged me £13 for their own mistake Normanlly I would want a refund but it’s a lesson well learnt for £13 NEVER to stay in a premier inn anywhere in the UK
